title: Leave
intro: Manage time-off requests and public holidays that affect schedules and payroll.

sections.title: Leave requests
steps: Review pending and approved leave for employees.
Approve or reject requests according to your HR role.
sections.caption: Leave tab.

sections.title: Holidays
sections.intro: Holidays mark non-working or premium-pay calendar days for the venue.
steps: Add venue holidays for the year.
Holiday dates feed scheduling and pay-rule calculations when configured.
sections.caption: Holidays tab.

sections.title: Leave request form
sections.intro: Submit or edit time-off requests against configured leave types.
steps: On Leave tab click Add request.
Select employee, leave type, and date range.
Enter day count and reason if required by the type.
Save — routes for approval when the type requires it.
sections.caption: Leave request form.

fields.name: Leave type
fields.effect: Determines paid/unpaid, approval, and accrual rules.

sections.title: Public holiday form
sections.intro: Public holidays interact with pay rules and scheduling.
steps: Add name, date, and country code.
Mark recurring for annual fixed dates.
Save — holiday appears in pay rule filters.
sections.caption: Public holiday form.

fields.name: Name
fields.effect: Holiday label in calendars and rules.

fields.name: Country code
fields.effect: Optional ISO code for multi-country venues.

fields.name: Is recurring
fields.effect: Repeats every year on the same month/day.

fields.name: Is active
fields.effect: Inactive holidays are ignored by new rules.
